coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): One Coder solely writes Support_Improvement_Report.docx from the canonical payload. coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): One Coder owns exactly one Google Form creation. Call create_form with title Customer Feedback Survey and description Help us improve our support services by sharing your feedback on recent issues. exactly once and retain formId. Sequentially add: a multiple-choice issue question with the literal top-five issue options; a multiple-choice satisfaction question with options 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; a free-text improvement question; a short-text recommendation-likelihood question explicitly asking for 1-10; and a free-text additional-comments question. Then call get_form(formId) and verify the ordered titles/types/options. Never search for a form through unsupported tools or retry an ambiguous creation.
